Sub:- Cancellation of exemption — Transfer of past accumulations 
regarding. 
Sir, 
Of late, a number of instances have come to the notice of Head Office, 
wherein the past accumulations have not been transferred to EPFO, after 
cancellation of exemption/relaxation by the appropriate authority thereby 
affecting the delivery of services to the members. 
• 
In this regard, your attention is invited towards condition no. 19 of para 
27AA of the EPF Scheme, 1952 which stipulates that "All such investments 
made, like purchase of securities and bonds, should be lodged in the safe 
custody of depository participants, approved by Reserve Bank of India and 
Central Government, who shall be the custodian of the same. On closure of 
establishment or liquidation or cancellation of exemption from EPF Scheme, 
1952 such custodian shall transfer the investment obtained in the name of the 
Trust and standing in its credit to the RPFC concerned directly on receipt of 
request from the RPFC concerned to that effect". 
Keeping in view the interest of the workers of such establishments, it is 
advised to invoke the said provisions of para 27AA of the EPF Scheme, 1952 in 
cases where the past accumulations have not been transferred after cancellation 
of exemption/relaxation. - RPFCs may also initiate all other necessary actions as 
required including prosecution action against the employer and the trustees to 
ensure that the past accumulations are transferred to the EPFO without any 
delay.
